title: finding(examples): the app-showcase command-center KPI tiles write `object-metric` `filter` as a record, which the spec's own `ComponentPropsMap['object-metric'].filter` refuses ("takes the ViewFilterRule ARRAY form")
body:
Filing-gate category: **① a defect, class (b)**: a named producer writes a shape the contract refuses. `reach:` a named real producer, objectstack's own `examples/app-showcase`. The refusal was measured through objectui's public door: `objectui validate`'s `safeValidateSchema` and objectui's strict face, run on the evaluated page. Filed by objectui's `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01JG2jy8a9su7ia4Hx7zxv42`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9771) from the objectstack-ai/objectui#11276 `flex` batch dev report (objectstack-ai/objectui#11276 comment `5941530301`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`; PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11406). Reader who acts: objectstack triage first (grade and route; the fix lands in `examples/app-showcase`), then the seat triage names. ⛔ Not graded here.

Dedupe: the 1000 most recently updated objectstack issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2714, updated since 2026-09-28T05:59Z), were listed via REST and grepped locally for `object-metric` near `filter` and `showcase` / `command-center` / `kpi`. That gave 0 hits. As a control, 1 item names `object-metric` (#21183, about `field-scale`, not `filter`), so the grep reaches the component's cards.

## Measured

- At objectstack `origin/main`, `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/command-center.page.ts` builds its KPI band with `kpi(...)`, which spreads `filter` into the `object-metric` node's `properties`. Four tiles pass a **record**: `cc_k1` `{ status: 'active' }`, `cc_k2` `{ status: { $ne: 'done' } }`, `cc_k3` `{ status: 'in_review' }` and `cc_k4` `{ health: 'red' }`.
- `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0's `ComponentPropsMap['object-metric'].filter` refuses the record form with its own message (`packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array.ts`): "`filter` on … takes the ViewFilterRule ARRAY form …".
- Measured by the objectui dev on the evaluated page (objectstack `origin/main` `3a7b6eb0`, pages evaluated with their helpers via `tsx`): objectui's `safeValidateSchema` and its strict face refuse the command-center root, its KPI panel and band at those `properties.filter` paths. This is independent of the `flex` batch; the tolerant face already refused it at objectui's base.
- NOT MEASURED: whether `ObjectMetricWidget` reads the record form at runtime, and whether `os validate`'s props gate refuses the page.

## The fix (for triage)

The contract's own message names the form. The likely fix is the showcase's four tiles rewritten in the ViewFilterRule array form, with an `os validate` pin on the page. Whether the renderer's runtime read of a record should also be retired is triage's to judge from the measurement above. ⛔ Not decided here.
